sloka: क्रोधवेगेन सं युक्तः सत्त्वेन च बलेन च ।अचलाग्रादथोत्थाय पुप्लुवे गोपुरस्थले ।। ६-४०-८।।
transliteration: krodhavegena saṁ yuktaḥ sattvena ca balena ca ।acalāgrādathotthāya pupluve gopurasthale ।। 6-40-8।।

translations.english: Provoked by anger, courageous and strong Sugriva rose up impelled by impetuosity and flew to the peak of the tower.
